privacy_geodata.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection
privacy_geodata.subtitle: Complete transparency: how FreshMarket processes location data, integrates third-party services, and protects personal information
privacy_geodata.section_coords_desc: When selecting a delivery point on the map, the application transmits numerical coordinates (latitude and longitude) and your network IP address to third-party mapping providers:
privacy_geodata.osm_bullet_1: OpenStreetMap & Nominatim: rendering map tiles and resolving street/district names from your selected pin location.
privacy_geodata.osm_bullet_2: Project OSRM: calculating road distance and visualizing the courier route from the market to your location.
privacy_geodata.osm_ip_note: External mapping servers receive your technical IP address and the selected pin coordinates. Personal contact details (name, phone, messenger, order items) are never transmitted to mapping servers. If you decline map usage or enter an address manually as text, GPS coordinates are never accessed.
privacy_geodata.thirdparty_desc: To ensure security, performance, and seamless authentication, FreshMarket integrates with trusted cloud providers:
privacy_geodata.thirdparty_bullet_supabase: Supabase Inc.: encrypted cloud PostgreSQL database, authentication session management (Supabase Auth), and real-time cart and order sync across your devices.
privacy_geodata.thirdparty_bullet_oauth: Google & Facebook OAuth: when signing in via social accounts, we only receive essential profile data (email, name, and public avatar).
privacy_geodata.thirdparty_bullet_cloudinary: Cloudinary Inc.: global media CDN for optimized product image delivery (processes client IP address and user-agent upon image requests).
privacy_geodata.thirdparty_bullet_fonts: Google Fonts: fast and secure loading of system typography (Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter). Google servers process standard HTTP headers.
privacy_geodata.storage_desc: FreshMarket does not use third-party advertising cookies or cross-site tracking trackers. Your browser's local storage (localStorage) only stores data necessary for PWA persistence and offline availability:
privacy_geodata.storage_bullet_profile: Contacts & profile: your name, phone number, preferred messenger (Telegram, WhatsApp, or phone call), and default delivery address.
privacy_geodata.storage_bullet_auth: Authentication session: Supabase Auth session token to keep you securely signed in between visits.
privacy_geodata.storage_bullet_cart: Shopping cart: active cart items, replacement preferences, and cross-tab/cross-device sync timestamps.
privacy_geodata.storage_bullet_orders: Order history: local cache of up to 30 recent orders (order numbers, totals, receipts, and delivery statuses).
privacy_geodata.storage_bullet_settings: UI preferences: selected language, active catalog tab, catalog grid layout, onboarding status, replacement policy, and recent delivery addresses.
privacy_geodata.private_desc: Your personal contacts and order details are strictly protected:
privacy_geodata.private_bullet_1: Your name, phone number, messenger handle, and order items are accessible only to you and your assigned market concierge for fulfillment and delivery.
privacy_geodata.private_bullet_2: We never sell, rent, or transfer your contact information to advertising networks, and we never send unsolicited promotional spam.
privacy_geodata.retention_desc: We retain personal data strictly as long as needed to fulfill services and comply with reporting requirements:
privacy_geodata.retention_bullet_local: In your browser (localStorage): stored until you sign out (signing out clears session, profile, and cart association) or manually clear your browser data. Order history is capped at the 30 most recent records.
privacy_geodata.retention_bullet_cloud: In the cloud database: user profiles are kept until account deletion is requested; completed orders are retained for delivery verification, receipt reconciliation, and accounting, or until a deletion request.
privacy_geodata.section_rights_title: 6. User Rights & Data Deletion (Right to Be Forgotten)
privacy_geodata.rights_desc: You have the right to request a full export or permanent deletion of your profile, contact details, and order history from our database at any time.
privacy_geodata.rights_contact_intro: To request account or data deletion, please reach out to FreshMarket support via any preferred channel:
privacy_geodata.footer_note: FreshMarket • Honest morning market produce delivered by your personal concierge
